{{Top|leg}}
The '''Affiliated Moisture Farmers''' was an organization of [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] surrounding the settlement of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The government of Anchorhead and the Affiliated Moisture Farmers passed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] ordinance that paid ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for every [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rat]] killed. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] earned enough money from the bounty to upgrade their [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhoppers]] and save for their education.<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
